note_on_unverifiable_names: Two baseline systems in the evidence package (Moatless Tools, credited to 'Orwall'; Aider, credited to 'Gauthier') are named without a year or 'et al.' form in the source material and are therefore NOT entered in this registry as citable literature (no year to satisfy the schema or the required (FirstAuthor et al., Year) citation form). They are still reported as baseline systems by name in the results tables, without a parenthetical citation, exactly as the evidence records them.
